data.name: List_Separator
data.comment: TextList.Join: the separator placed between every item of a joined list except the last two, which List_And/List_Or's own template joins instead.

data.name: List_And
data.comment: TextList.And: {0} is every item but the last, already joined by List_Separator; {1} is the last item. Every item is a client-language name (item, produce or character), never itself translated.

data.name: List_Or
data.comment: TextList.Or: {0} is every item but the last, already joined by List_Separator; {1} is the last item. Every item is a client-language name (item, produce or character), never itself translated.

data.name: Duration_About
data.comment: Phrases.AboutDays/AboutHours: {0} is the complete Duration_Days/Duration_Hours noun phrase this wraps.

data.name: Duration_Days_One
data.comment: Phrases.Days, singular branch (n == 1): {0} is the day count, already formatted through Formats.Number.

data.name: Duration_Days_Other
data.comment: Phrases.Days, plural branch (n != 1, including 0 and fractional values like 1.5): {0} is the day count, already formatted through Formats.Number.

data.name: Duration_Hours_One
data.comment: Phrases.Hours, singular branch (n == 1): {0} is the hour count, already formatted through Formats.Number.

data.name: Duration_Hours_Other
data.comment: Phrases.Hours, plural branch (n != 1, including 0 and fractional values): {0} is the hour count, already formatted through Formats.Number.

data.name: Duration_Every
data.comment: Phrases.EveryDay, non-1-day branch: {0} is the Duration_Days noun phrase for the cadence.

data.name: Duration_EveryDay
data.comment: Phrases.EveryDay, exact 24-hour branch: no slot, since "every 1 day" reads worse than the idiomatic form.

data.name: Phrase_UnknownCount
data.comment: Phrases.OneNumberOrRange, no-data branch: a quantity adjective substituted before a produce/seed name elsewhere; the yield-tier meaning itself is unrecorded so no number can be quoted.

data.name: Phrase_NumberRange
data.comment: Phrases.OneNumberOrRange, disagreeing-tiers branch: {0} is the minimum tier, {1} the maximum, both already formatted through Formats.Number.

data.name: GardeningItems_SoilNameUnresolved
data.value: no item id recorded for grade {0} {1} soil
data.comment: GardeningItems.SoilName fallback: only reachable when a soilIds entry fails to resolve against the live Item sheet at startup. {0} is the grade number; {1} is the SoilFamily enum name, left untranslated per the do-not-translate register since no real item name could be resolved for it.

data.name: GardeningItems_NoSoilPinned
data.comment: GardeningItems.SoilUnavailable, SoilPreference.Fixed with no item pinned. "FixedSoilItemId" names Configuration's own field and stays literal.

data.name: GardeningItems_PinnedSoilNotRecognised
data.value: Pinned soil item {0} is not a recognised topsoil.
data.comment: GardeningItems.SoilUnavailable, SoilPreference.Fixed pinned to an item id that resolves to no known soil. {0} is that raw item id, an integer, not a client-language name.

data.name: GardeningItems_SoilFamilyNotInBag
data.value: You hold no soil of this kind. {0} is the one to get.
data.comment: GardeningItems.SoilUnavailable, family branch, shown when BestSoil found no grade at all of the requested family held. Two sentences on purpose: the first states what is missing (the whole family, not one grade), the second names the best grade as guidance. {0} is a client-language item name from GardeningItems.SoilName - see composition contract rule 6 for why no article precedes it.

data.name: GardeningItems_SoilNotInBag
data.comment: GardeningItems.SoilUnavailable, shown when BestSoil found none of the requested soil held. {0} is the resolved soil item's real name (via GardeningItems.SoilName or ItemSheet.Name), a client-language item name — see composition contract rule 6 for why the article stays outside the slot.

data.name: Duration_Minutes_One

data.name: Duration_Minutes_Other

data.name: SeedItems_ProduceRowFallback
data.comment: SeedItems.ProduceName fallback, reachable only when a GardeningSeed row's produce item does not resolve against the live Item sheet. {0} is the raw row id, an integer via Formats.Number.

data.name: SeedItems_ItemRowFallback
data.comment: SeedItems.SeedItemName fallback (the shared helper Task 2.5 consolidated from three former per-file copies), reachable only when a GardeningSeed row's seed item does not resolve against the live Item sheet. {0} is the raw row id, an integer via Formats.Number.

data.name: Goal_TabLabel
data.comment: MainWindow.Draw, the visible half of "Goal###goalTab" (kept with its "###goalTab" id suffix, see Garden_TabLabel for why).

data.name: Goal_CurrentGoal
data.comment: MainWindow.DrawGoalTab, the current-goal line. {0} is the target's produce name, a client-language name.

data.name: Goal_PickSomethingElseButton
data.comment: MainWindow.DrawGoalTab, reopens DrawGoalPicker over the current goal.

data.name: Goal_ClearGoalButton
data.comment: MainWindow.DrawGoalTab, sets GardenJournal.GoalSeedRow back to 0.

data.name: Goal_PickerIntro
data.value: Pick what you want to grow and Gardener works out the steps from what you already hold.
data.comment: MainWindow.DrawGoalPicker, empty-state intro shown above the quick picks and the seed list.

data.name: Goal_PickerHeader
data.comment: MainWindow.DrawGoalPicker, header above the search box and seed list.

data.name: Goal_PickerSearchHint
data.comment: MainWindow.DrawGoalPicker, InputTextWithHint placeholder for the "##goalSearch" search box.

data.name: Goal_PickerRowLabel
data.comment: MainWindow.DrawGoalPicker, one seed row's Selectable label (kept with its own "##goalpick-{row}" id suffix, appended outside this key). {0} is the produce name, a client-language name; {1} is the already-localized PickerTag phrase (Goal_TagGatherable / Goal_TagCrossbreedOnly / Goal_TagNoCrossData).

data.name: Goal_TagGatherable
data.value: you can buy or gather this
data.comment: MainWindow.PickerTag, SeedTable.Gatherable(row) == true branch. A standalone noun phrase substituted into Goal_PickerRowLabel.

data.name: Goal_TagCrossbreedOnly
data.comment: MainWindow.PickerTag, SeedTable.CrossableTargets branch. A standalone noun phrase substituted into Goal_PickerRowLabel.

data.name: Goal_TagNoCrossData
data.comment: MainWindow.PickerTag fallback, covering both a row absent from the bundle and one present but missing its cross data. A standalone noun phrase substituted into Goal_PickerRowLabel. "Settings" names Gardener's own settings window.

data.name: Goal_QuickPicksHeader
data.value: Quickest from what you hold right now:
data.comment: MainWindow.DrawQuickPicks header, shown above the up-to-three quick-pick buttons.

data.name: Goal_AlreadyHold
data.comment: MainWindow.DrawGoalAlreadyMet, the opening line. {0} is the held count, an integer via Formats.Number; {1} is the seed item's own name (SeedItems.SeedItemName), a client-language name - count-first construction per composition contract rule 6, no article before {1}.

data.name: Goal_GrowTimeUnknown
data.value: Gardener does not know how long this seed takes to grow.
data.comment: MainWindow.DrawGoalAlreadyMet, shown when SeedTable.Grow has no grow time recorded for the goal row.

data.name: Goal_AlreadyMetPlan
data.value: Plant one in {0} and harvest in {1} for {2} {3} and {4} seed back.
data.comment: MainWindow.DrawGoalAlreadyMet, the planting/harvest economics line. {0} is the resolved yield-soil item name (GardeningItems.SoilName), a client-language item name, preceded by "in" per composition contract rule 6 rather than an article; {1} is a complete duration noun phrase from Phrases.AboutDays/AboutHours; {2} is the crop-yield count phrase from Phrases.OneNumberOrRange; {3} is the produce name, a client-language name; {4} is the seed-yield count phrase from Phrases.OneNumberOrRange.

data.name: Goal_SeedReturnNone
data.value: It gives back no seeds when harvested, so plant another from your stock each time.
data.comment: MainWindow.DrawGoalAlreadyMet, seed-yield-tier branch selected when every recorded tier is 0. Key selection rather than a substituted count, per composition contract rule 3.

data.name: Goal_SeedReturnOne
data.value: It gives back the one seed you planted, at any soil grade, so a bed sustains itself but never multiplies.
data.comment: MainWindow.DrawGoalAlreadyMet, seed-yield-tier branch selected when every recorded tier is 1. Key selection rather than a substituted count, per composition contract rule 3.

data.name: Goal_SeedReturnMany
data.value: It gives back {0} seeds at any soil grade, so a bed of these multiplies over time.
data.comment: MainWindow.DrawGoalAlreadyMet, seed-yield-tier branch selected when every recorded tier agrees on a value other than 0 or 1. {0} is that tier value, an integer via Formats.Number.

data.name: Goal_NoCrossbreedNeeded
data.value: You do not need to crossbreed {0}.
data.comment: MainWindow.DrawGoalNoCrossbreedNeeded, opening line. {0} is the goal's produce name, a client-language name.

data.name: Goal_SourcesWhere
data.comment: MainWindow.DrawGoalNoCrossbreedNeeded, shown when SeedTable.Sources has at least one entry. {0} is the bundled English source text joined with "; " (SeedTable.Sources, Decision 3 - out of scope for translation).

data.name: Goal_SourcesNotRecorded
data.comment: MainWindow.DrawGoalNoCrossbreedNeeded fallback, shown when SeedTable.Sources has no entries.

data.name: Goal_NoRouteCannotGrow
data.value: Gardener cannot find a way to grow {0} from seeds you can buy or gather.
data.comment: MainWindow.DrawGoalNoRoute, first of three sentences (split per composition contract rule 4 rather than one long composed paragraph). {0} is the goal's produce name, a client-language name.

data.name: Goal_NoRouteNoParentPair
data.value: Its crossbreed data has no parent pair for it, so there is nothing to plan.
data.comment: MainWindow.DrawGoalNoRoute, second of three sentences.

data.name: Goal_NoRouteCheckSettings
data.value: Open Settings and check Data health.
data.comment: MainWindow.DrawGoalNoRoute, third of three sentences. "Settings" and "Data health" name Gardener's own settings window and section.

data.name: Goal_NeverSeenGarden
data.value: Gardener has never seen a garden of yours. Stand at your plot once and it will know which step you are on.
data.comment: MainWindow.DrawGoalPlanBody, shown when the player is away from the garden and GardenJournal.AllRecords is empty.

data.name: Goal_NotAtGarden
data.value: You are not at the garden.
data.comment: MainWindow.DrawGoalPlanBody, first of two sentences shown when away from the garden with a cached journal snapshot (split per composition contract rule 4).

data.name: Goal_LastVisitAge
data.value: This is what Gardener saw on your last visit, {0} ago.
data.comment: MainWindow.DrawGoalPlanBody, second of the two away-from-garden sentences. {0} is a complete duration noun phrase from MainWindow.GoalAgePhrase (Phrases.Minutes/Hours/Days).

data.name: Goal_StepProgress
data.comment: MainWindow.DrawGoalPlanBody, current-step-of-total header. {0} is the current step's own Number; {1} is the highest step Number in the plan, both integers via Formats.Number.

data.name: Goal_TotalStepsCount
data.comment: MainWindow.DrawGoalPlanBody, first of three summary sentences (split per composition contract rule 4 rather than one composed line). {0} is the plan's total step count, an integer via Formats.Number.

data.name: Goal_BestCaseDuration
data.value: About {0} if the gamble lands first time.
data.comment: MainWindow.DrawGoalPlanBody, second summary sentence. {0} is a complete duration noun phrase from Phrases.Days/Hours over plan.BestCaseDuration.

data.name: Goal_PeakBeds
data.comment: MainWindow.DrawGoalPlanBody, third summary sentence. {0} is plan.PeakBeds, an integer via Formats.Number.

data.name: Goal_StepHeader
data.comment: MainWindow.DrawGoalStepGroup, the visible half of the "###goalstep-{number}"-suffixed CollapsingHeader (id suffix appended outside this key, keyed off the step number rather than the title - see the code comment at the call site). {0} is the step's Number, an integer via Formats.Number; {1} is GoalStep.Title, generated by Planner/GoalRoute.cs (Phase 6 scope) and rendered here as-is.

data.name: Goal_MarkerNow
data.comment: MainWindow.DrawGoalStepGroup, right-aligned marker shown on the current step's header.

data.name: Goal_MarkerDone
data.comment: MainWindow.DrawGoalStepGroup, right-aligned marker shown on a step header once every member is GoalStepStatus.Done.

data.name: Goal_StepDoneWithSeed
data.comment: MainWindow.StatusLine, GoalStepStatus.Done branch, shared by ObtainStep and CrossStep (same sentence either way - only which seed row is being counted differs). {0} is the held count, an integer via Formats.Number; {1} is the seed item's own name (SeedItems.SeedItemName), a client-language name - count-first construction per composition contract rule 6.

data.name: Goal_StepDonePlain
data.comment: MainWindow.StatusLine, GoalStepStatus.Done fallback for a GoalStep subtype that is neither ObtainStep nor CrossStep.

data.name: Goal_AttemptUnresolved
data.value: Bed {0} is growing. You will know whether it crossed when it is ready to harvest.
data.comment: MainWindow.StatusLine, GoalStepStatus.AttemptUnresolved branch. {0} is the bed number, an integer via Formats.Number.

data.name: Goal_NotStarted
data.comment: MainWindow.StatusLine fallback (GoalStepStatus.NotStarted with no GoalStepProgress.Blocker set - Blocker itself is generated in Planner/GoalProgress.cs, Phase 6 scope, and rendered as-is when present).

data.name: Goal_GrowingUnknownTiming
data.value: Growing in bed {0}. Gardener does not know when this one is ready. Set when you planted it on the Garden tab.
data.comment: MainWindow.GrowingStatusLine, shown when the bed record is missing or its harvest window confidence is HarvestConfidence.Unknown. {0} is the bed number, an integer via Formats.Number.

data.name: Goal_ReadyToHarvest
data.comment: MainWindow.GrowingStatusLine, shown once the harvest window's earliest time has passed. {0} is the bed number, an integer via Formats.Number.

data.name: Goal_WiltedTendBeforeWithers
data.value: Growing in bed {0}. It has wilted; tend it before it withers.
data.comment: MainWindow.GrowingStatusLine, shown once the bed has wilted but has not yet withered. {0} is the bed number, an integer via Formats.Number.

data.name: Goal_TendWithinHours_One
data.value: Growing in bed {0}. Tend it within {1} hour or it wilts.
data.comment: MainWindow.GrowingStatusLine, singular branch (n == 1), shown when the bed wilts within 6 hours. {0} is the bed number; {1} is the whole hours remaining until wilt (rounded up), both integers via Formats.Number.

data.name: Goal_TendWithinHours_Other
data.value: Growing in bed {0}. Tend it within {1} hours or it wilts.
data.comment: MainWindow.GrowingStatusLine, plural branch (n != 1, including 0), shown when the bed wilts within 6 hours. {0} is the bed number; {1} is the whole hours remaining until wilt (rounded up), both integers via Formats.Number.

data.name: Goal_GrowingNoEarliest
data.comment: MainWindow.GrowingStatusLine fallback, shown when the harvest window carries no earliest time at all. {0} is the bed number, an integer via Formats.Number.

data.name: Goal_GrowingTimeLeft
data.value: Growing in bed {0}. About {1} left, at the earliest.
data.comment: MainWindow.GrowingStatusLine, confident-timing branch. {0} is the bed number, an integer via Formats.Number; {1} is a complete duration noun phrase from Phrases.Days/Hours. Sibling of Goal_GrowingTimeLeftEstimated rather than a shared template with a concatenated suffix, since a trailing comma-clause does not compose in Spanish (composition contract rule 3).

data.name: Goal_GrowingTimeLeftEstimated
data.value: Growing in bed {0}. About {1} left, at the earliest, estimated.
data.comment: MainWindow.GrowingStatusLine, HarvestConfidence.Estimated branch - the whole-sentence sibling of Goal_GrowingTimeLeft, selected instead of appending a ", estimated" suffix onto it. {0} is the bed number, an integer via Formats.Number; {1} is a complete duration noun phrase from Phrases.Days/Hours.

data.name: Goal_StandAtGardenSeeBeds
data.value: Stand at your garden to see which beds this uses.
data.comment: MainWindow.DrawGoalCurrentStepDetail, shown above the disabled handoff when the player is away from the garden.

data.name: Goal_StandAtGardenPlantHandoff
data.value: Stand at your garden to plant this step.
data.comment: MainWindow.DrawGoalCurrentStepDetail, the disabled handoff's own reason when the player is away from the garden.

data.name: Goal_NeedBothSeeds
data.value: You need {0} and {1} to plant this step.
data.comment: MainWindow.MissingSeedForHandoff, whole disabled-reason sentence for the branch where neither seed is held at all. {0} and {1} are the two seed items' own names (SeedItems.SeedItemName), client-language names. A whole sentence rather than a noun-phrase fragment, since this and Goal_NeedOneMoreSeed inflect differently in Spanish and cannot share one host template.

data.name: Goal_NeedOneMoreSeed
data.value: You need 1 more {0} to plant this step.
data.comment: MainWindow.MissingSeedForHandoff, whole disabled-reason sentence shared by both single-seed-missing branches (first seed short, or second seed short - same sentence shape either way). {0} is the missing seed item's own name (SeedItems.SeedItemName), a client-language name.

data.name: Goal_NoSoilForStepFallback
data.value: You have no soil for this step.
data.comment: MainWindow.DrawGoalCurrentStepDetail fallback, used only when GardeningItems.SoilUnavailable itself returns null.

data.name: Goal_MineHint
data.comment: MainWindow.DrawGoalCurrentStepDetail, appended as its own sentence after the soil-unavailable reason (space joined in code, not composed via a slot) whenever the soil preference is not SoilPreference.Fixed. {0} is SoilSources.Where's own location noun phrase, containing bundled English zone text (Decision 3, out of scope for translation).

data.name: Goal_PairBedPlantHere
data.comment: MainWindow.DrawGoalCurrentStepDetail, pair-strip cell for a bed the single-step plan will plant into (LayoutPlan.ExpectedTargets). {0} is the bed number, an integer via Formats.Number; {1} is the produce name, a client-language name.

data.name: Goal_PairBedExisting
data.comment: MainWindow.DrawGoalCurrentStepDetail, pair-strip cell for a bed already holding the seed the plan reads (not one of LayoutPlan.ExpectedTargets). {0} is the bed number, an integer via Formats.Number; {1} is the produce name, a client-language name.

data.name: Goal_CannotFitStep
data.value: Gardener cannot fit this step into the free beds on this patch.
data.comment: MainWindow.DrawGoalHandoff, shown when CrossPlanner.Verify rejects the single-step plan.

data.name: Goal_PlantStepButton
data.comment: MainWindow.DrawGoalHandoff, the handoff button (Decision 2: borrows the game's own bed-menu verb, like the sweep buttons). {0} is GameWords.Action(MenuKey.SetSeed), the game's own "Plant Seeds" wording.

data.name: Goal_ConfirmPlantStepTitle
data.comment: MainWindow.DrawGoalHandoff, confirm popup title (the "Confirm plant goal step" popup id is a literal identifier, never translated).

data.name: Goal_ConfirmPlantStepBody
data.value: Gardener will plant {0}. It plants this one step and stops.
data.comment: MainWindow.DrawGoalHandoff, confirm popup body. {0} is MainWindow.PlantingPhrase's own roster of seed/bed/soil clauses, itself built from Goal_PlantingClause_One/_Other joined with "; ".

data.name: Goal_PlantingClause_One
data.comment: MainWindow.PlantingPhrase, singular branch (one bed in the group). {0} is the seed item's own name (SeedItems.SeedItemName); {1} is the bed number, joined through TextList.And (a single number when there is only one); {2} is the soil item's own name (ItemSheet.Name). Both {0} and {2} are client-language item names.

data.name: Goal_PlantingClause_Other
data.comment: MainWindow.PlantingPhrase, plural branch (more than one bed in the group). {0} is the seed item's own name (SeedItems.SeedItemName); {1} is the bed numbers joined through TextList.And; {2} is the soil item's own name (ItemSheet.Name). Both {0} and {2} are client-language item names.
